主要内容: On June 24, 2020, NOVAVAX INC received $76.0 million from the Coalition for Epidemic Preparedness Innovations under a restated funding agreement. CEPI will provide up to $384.5 million to support the development of NVX-CoV2373, the Company’s coronavirus vaccine candidate against SARS-CoV-2. The $76.0 million is forgivable and does not bear interest. The Company is only expected to repay the amount if it sells its vaccine, produced with the funds, to a third party. Additionally, on June 25, 2020, NOVAVAX INC shareholders approved the Amended 2015 Stock Plan, increasing stock award limits and adding 7,100,000 shares of Common Stock available for issuance.
